snippet.title: Davy X Jones - Exclusive Developer Interview - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
Y'arrr. It be an exclusive developer interview with Parasight, the dev team behind Davy X Jones, a new first-person action-adventure game where you play as a notorious headless pirate, the titular Davy Jones. No release date yet but it will be heading to PC and consoles. Give it a wishlist on Steam if you like the look of it! 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #davyxjones
